reproducedDefect.reason: The current School/Class Feel gate uses ephemeral ClassSessionController.completed state. After a new server/controller is constructed, durable ProgressionRepository still contains the class completion but Class/Education no longer knows the current class was completed and accepts re-entry. This breaks the current slice's 'class complete -> free roam until next bell' behavior across rejoin and can drive a duplicate/conflicting progression attempt.
reproducedDefect.exactExitCriterion: On a canonical descendant of 99e12750, after class 1:2:math is durably completed and Class/Education ephemeral state is reconstructed while the same Foundation classKey remains current, server-authoritative class entry must be rejected as already completed, returnToFreeRoam must remain true, durable progression completionCount must remain 1, and no progressionPending state may be created. Existing Foundation, EducationEngine, Class/Education leakage/idempotency/late-submission tests and Progression exactly-once/save-rejoin tests must remain green.
